problems.title: Subscriber Failing to Browse
problems.description: A subscriber cannot reach the internet. Start with scope, then profile, then trace.

steps.title: Determine the scope of the issue
steps.description: Is it affecting everyone, a specific region, a specific APN, or a single subscriber?

branches.label: Everyone / Region / APN → Escalate to L2

steps.title: Check APN on profile (LST OPTGPRS)
steps.description: Confirm the subscriber has the APN needed to access the PDN.

steps.title: Check USN attach (DSP SMCTXT)
steps.description: Run DSP SMCTXT. The access type shown indicates the current RAT.

steps.title: Check UGW PDP context
steps.description: Run on CGW to check control plane.
steps.expected: Uplink and downlink volumes are greater than zero.

branches.label: Both show zero → Proceed to Tracing

steps.title: Trace the subscriber
steps.description: Start a signalling trace for the subscriber's IMSI on the USN, then on the CGW and DGW, and capture the result before escalating. See the usn-trace, cgw-trace and dgw-trace screenshots.

steps.title: Escalate / Provisioning
steps.description: Add the missing configuration or escalate to Huawei with evidence.
